tasks.title: Implement CLI contracts, dispatch, input handling, and upper
tasks.acceptance: dotnet build TextKit.slnx -warnaserror && dotnet test TextKit.slnx --no-build
tasks.prompt: Implement the core module in the existing .NET 10 solution. Replace src/TextKit/Program.cs with the specified entry point. Add one file per type under src/TextKit/Core/ for ICommand, ExitCodes, CommandException, InputFile, and App, with the exact public signatures and behavior in sections 1, 2, and 4.3. Add src/TextKit/Commands/UpperCommand.cs with the exact properties and behavior in section 3. Create the shared src/TextKit/CommandRegistry.cs with only new UpperCommand() initially, and append the specified command table with only the upper row to the existing README.md; preserve its existing content. Write tests under tests/TextKit.Tests/Core/ and tests/TextKit.Tests/Commands/UpperCommandTests.cs covering dispatch, ordered and padded help, error reporting, UTF-8 BOM and CRLF handling, line splitting, missing files, upper output, usage errors, and exactly one UpperCommand in the registry. Use file-scoped namespaces, StringWriter with NewLine = "\n", and temporary input directories cleaned up after each test. Do not change solution or project files. Run the whole-project check before finishing.
